content: In this work we introduce a model for forecasting conversational events that overcomes both these inherent challenges by processing comments, and their relations, as they happen (i.e., in an online fashion). Our main insight is that models with these properties already exist, albeit geared toward generation rather than prediction: recent work in context-aware dialog generation (or “chatbots”) has proposed sequential neural models that make effective use of the intra-conversational dynamics BIBREF22, BIBREF23, BIBREF24, while concomitantly being able to process the conversation as it develops (see BIBREF25 for a survey).
